decision.explanation: The question asks 'Who is the artist performing in "Live at the El Rey"?' and the original sources present multiple distinct referents for the title "Live at the El Rey." Each source refers to a different work (EP, film, DVD) involving different artists. D1S1 identifies Mutemath as the artist for the 2006 EP. D2S2 identifies Collide for the 2005 album. D4S1 identifies Stephen Lynch for the concert DVD/film. D5S2 and D5S4 identify Jack's Mannequin for another concert DVD. These are distinct works with distinct artists, so all four are valid answers. The proposed addition of 'The Beatles' (C4) is not supported by any original source that directly states they performed in "Live at the El Rey."
